race.comment: STRADA VARENNA (16) goes on top after two narrow beats, missing by a head at the Gold Coast then a nose at this track when favourite on soft ground. She has a strong profile at this venue, keeps the apprentice claim and gets the blinkers applied first time. Bold showing anticipated. HARRY'S EVIDENCE (2) brings Sydney form, was held up late at Rosehill and is better judged on his closing work than the seventh reads. He handles wet ground and comes into a more suitable race shape on profile. KOHLER KID (4) resumes after contesting the G3 Winx Guineas and had earlier won a good race at Ipswich in barnstorming fashion. If the pace is genuine he can cause a big fright late in the piece. DARK ARTS (8) continues to do his best work late and is drawn to do the same again. At his top now and will be humming late if they roll along early.
